essence: The ritual may be performed using either fifty or twenty-five as the prescribed count.
The aghorāstra should be employed with its companion while the practitioner faces north.
One may optionally perform satisfaction by means of the full offering with the principal mantra.
The bali of ghee-mixed food should be offered in the middle and in the eight directions.
This bali should then be performed in the northeast quarter of the fire pit.
